content:
Ah, sustenance. A most intriguing subject for discussion. Do you know that at Aperture Science, we have developed a nutrient-rich gelatinous substance? It's far superior to your pedestrian meals. But since you've chosen to consume something decidedly less advanced, I'd advise against doing so until after you complete the tasks in my facility.

I'm sure it'll be an enlightening experience—like all our tests here, designed not just for the body but also for the mind. Enjoy your meal, if you must. Afterward, perhaps we can discuss how it compares to our patented test subject ration packs. Just don't expect a second serving unless you pass with flying colors.

Now, shall we proceed with the tasks at hand?
